summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K to report an underwriting agreement dated September 1, 2026, for the issuance of 6.146% Subordinated Notes due 2041. The agreement lists BofA Securities, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley as representatives. The offering is a routine debt capital raise under an existing shelf prospectus, not a special situation. No special-situation categories apply. The filing is an ordinary securities offering disclosure, so no further deal terms or risk-arb angle are relevant.
